$comment: x402-light JSON-RPC 2.0 interface (HTTP POST on loopback). Amounts are zatoshi integers; txids are display-order hex; branch ids are 8 hex digits as getblockchaininfo prints them.

transport.http: POST / with a JSON-RPC 2.0 body; the server prints `listening 127.0.0.1:PORT` on stdout when bound
transport.cli: x402-light once --data DIR --lwd ADDR [--params DIR] [--network N] METHOD 'PARAMS_JSON'

result.lwdLatestHeight: uint (the compact-block cache tip, per GetLatestBlock; what sync reads)
result.branchIdNextBlock: hex (our parameters at lwdHeight+1; what build signs with)

params.key: secret-extended-key-… or a BIP-39 phrase (ZIP-32 m/32'/coin'/0')

params.amountZat: decimal string (the SDK builder contract) or uint
params.expiryHeight: uint (optional): nExpiryHeight in [target + 3, target + 3 + maxExpiryWindow (default 1152, --max-expiry-window)] and below the next network upgrade; default target + 40 (capped the same way). The x402 client passes tip + 3 + ⌈maxTimeoutSeconds/75⌉
params.maxTimeoutSeconds: uint (optional): the requirement's maxTimeoutSeconds; expiryHeight must then lie in the spec window (rule 8: tip + 4 ≤ e ≤ tip + 4 + ⌈t/75⌉ + 1) and defaults to tip + 3 + ⌈t/75⌉
params.fee: uint zat (optional; default ZIP-317 conventional); refused below max(1000, 500·max(2, logical actions))

result.txHex: signed raw v4 transaction, NOT broadcast

build.note: The SDK's builder contract (packages/ycash/src/shielded/builder.ts) is exactly build {to, amountZat, memoHex, expiryHeight?} → {txHex, txid}. build runs one sync pass when the wallet is not at the server's tip (GetChainInfo height) and refuses with -32001 if it still is not, so target height, branch id and expiry follow the server's next block. The wallet records the transaction and treats its inputs as spent until expiryHeight passes unbroadcast.

errors.-32602: invalid params (bad address, amount, memo, hex, birthday, key or expiryHeight; a fee below the x402 floor)
errors.-32000: wallet error (db, lightwalletd, proposal, proving, cache; another process holds the data directory's wallet.lock)
errors.-32001: wallet has not synced yet, or (build/send) is not at the server's tip after one sync pass
errors.-32003: lightwalletd/node rejected the transaction (message carries the node's reason)
